about: Health V1a (docs/gameplay/survival_health_v1a.md 7): the medical alcohol bottle without its cap, held in the right hand by the player action item/alcohol_clean; the cap is the prop medical_alcohol_cap. Drawn as the bottle and label parts of the item's equipment mesh (tools/build-equipment-meshes-v1.mjs BOTTLE: 9.25 px tall, r 1.7 px, mouth at 9.0 px; item offset 0.2109375). Points (item block units): grip, where the right palm holds it, beside the body (the palm's middle 2.05 px off the bottle's side); mouth, the open mouth's middle; mouth_tip, 1 px further out along the axis (client/MedicalPourJets: the stream's way); base, the foot's middle.
